description: List the tracks (also called topics or categories) a conference accepts submissions under, with how many papers are in each. Use it to answer 'what tracks do we have', to summarize submissions by topic, or to find the track id that add_reviewer needs when recording a reviewer's expertise. Track names are also what list_submissions reports per paper, so this is how to see the full set rather than only the ones that happen to appear. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name: list_tracks
title: List an event's tracks
